correctness.rationale: The C++ verifier exhausts (4^10-1)/3=349525 scalar-normalized cubic forms over F4 and tests all 21 points, gradients, 21 line intersections and tangents. Exactly 248928 are nonsingular at every rational zero, of which tangent and blocking sets coincide, with 6328 equations split 280 at 9 points and 6048 at 10. The independent Python verifier enumerates all 1008 nondegenerate conics with 6 disjoint rational lines each, all 280 nine-point unitals and all 60480 projectivities. It proves that every one of 6328 selected equations is in one of the two representatives’ complete projective orbits and checks stabilizers. Geometry of each representative separately proves geometric smoothness of Hermitian and rational nonsingularity of external LQ. Complete finite enumeration only; no infinite argument implied.
